notes: FROZEN — the DSH LM Studio/qwen surface proves basic per-turn usage but not the complete token-accounting scenario. Real assistant/message usage records contain inputTokens, outputTokens, and totalTokens only. The DSH parser maps those fields into a TokenSnapshot and PerTurnContribution, so cumulative basic tokens are positive and monotonic across turns. No measured record contains cacheReadTokens or cacheWriteTokens, and parseAssistantUsage does not read either optional field. A lifecycle plus tokens_nonzero spec would therefore pass while proving nothing about the required cache-read bucket or zero fresh input. No phases are asserted. Unblock requires a real configured-provider cache trace and daemon mapping for its cache fields.
